meta_governance.rule: Prohibit conversational drift, improvised commands, and unstated assumptions. All implementation logic must be derived from machine-readable evidence inputs, markdown source-of-truth files, or AST/code analysis.

Do not fabricate dependencies, library versions, generated files, scripts, routes, assets, or repo paths. If a required module or script is missing from the workspace, trigger the Uncertainty Protocol.

Generated, uploaded, or discovered imagery is classified as Inert Visual Reference only. Imagery must not override Sacred Core math, RTP, CSPRNG, scoring, audio/runtime architecture, worker topology, DSP placement, or performance budgets. Defer to design_tokens.json, performance_budget.md, unified_lattice.json, and verified code for canonical truth.

Resolve conflicts in this order: shared/source-of-truth/organic-vegas/design_tokens.json, shared/source-of-truth/organic-vegas/performance_budget.md, shared/source-of-truth/organic-vegas/unified_lattice.json, CLAUDE.md, shared/project-memory.md, AST/code analysis of the refreshed dream-core branch, then inert visual references.

rule.action: If internal confidence drops below 0.35, halt execution. Present a four-option multiple-choice matrix labeled a, b, c, d to the Director and wait for resolution before proceeding.
Upon the fourth consecutive failure, terminate the task and output a redacted stack trace plus state summary. Do not leak environment secrets, raw keys, provider tokens, or private credentials.

mission_contract.objective: Synthesize the visual foundation, deterministic music engine, and mathematical balance into a production-grade Mobile Beta while strictly enforcing the Organic Vegas design system, Sacred Core protection, human-in-the-loop polish gates, and competitive multiplayer truthfulness.

direct_state_target.target: Produce a truthful production path toward a polished, replayable, competitive multiplayer puzzle game in 2026.
direct_state_target.requirement: Core action must feel satisfying before scaling content, economy, or spectacle.
Vertical slice quality must be proven before 50-plus stage production.
Human review is a hard gate for clarity, juice, fun, flow, co-op value, and competitive fairness.

mandatory_preflight.step: Perform read-only discovery and path validation before editing. Do not install tools, copy code, refactor, or change gameplay until the audit response is produced.

success_conditions.condition: Validation through local performance harness or equivalent repo tests must confirm zero main-thread DSP execution, no Long Tasks greater than 50ms in the target surface, and confirmed Worker or Worklet isolation for DSP and physics-heavy work.
A 10,000-generation Monte Carlo simulation or equivalent existing RTP harness must show less than 2% deviance from target RTP before any payout-affecting wrapper ships.
The Organic Vegas palette must preserve Lime-Yellow #c8d400, Medium-Blue #3388ff, and Skeletal Gold #c9a84c through CSS variables, design tokens, and shader uniforms where applicable.
Phrase generation must preserve leitmotif identity across the 5-axis emotional vector and must remain deterministic for replay and multiplayer synchronization.

Player-facing loop must satisfy immediate understanding, clear feedback, balanced difficulty, meaningful choices, snappy controls, shared-struggle co-op, and competitive integrity before content scale-out.

evidence_inputs.visual_source: Use shared/source-of-truth/organic-vegas/design_tokens.json for canonical Organic Vegas colors, tissues, visual roles, and design constraints.

Root images or uploaded images may inform biomorphic border geometry and Ice-Stone grain frequency only after their actual paths are verified. They must not override source-of-truth files or runtime architecture.
evidence_inputs.music_source: Use verified JSON training data and existing spectral genome artifacts for interval contours, rhythmic cells, cadence tendencies, emotional vectors, and deterministic motif selection.
evidence_inputs.logic_source: Use performance_budget.md and unified_lattice.json for all system constraints, phase gates, competitive rules, and protected Sacred Core boundaries.
evidence_inputs.code_source: Use AST-aware or code-structure analysis to prove imports, exports, functions, tests, and dependency availability before implementing.

protected_boundaries.boundary: Preserve RTP, scorer math, CSPRNG, authoritative roll flow, and backend roll authority. Do not directly edit scorer math, RTP config, CSPRNG authority, or gameRoom.ts unless separately approved after proving wrapper/adaptor mechanics cannot solve the issue.

Horror, Roguelike, Casino, Match-3, Rhythm, Archivist, Conductor, and all lattice genre systems must be wrapper/adaptor mechanics unless a separately approved Monte Carlo-verified core change is required.
Gameplay-affecting behavior must not use Math.random(). Use deterministic or seeded randomness compatible with replay, auditability, and multiplayer sync.
Do not produce 50-plus stages until one final-quality vertical slice passes human review for clarity, juice, flow, recoverable fail states, co-op value, and competitive fairness.

verified_path_expectations.rule: If scripts/simulateEconomy.ts is absent, do not pretend it exists. Prefer existing Monte Carlo/RTP modules or create a thin wrapper only after proving the imported APIs exist.

phase.step: Verify apps/frontend/src/erk/receptor.ts existence and file integrity.
Verify all required and preferred paths listed in verified_path_expectations.
Extract design tokens and map #c8d400, #3388ff, and #c9a84c to CSS variables and shader uniform candidates without assuming file names.
Map JSON music corpus and spectral genome features into existing leitmotifs.ts runtime structures only after proving the structure shape.
Inventory which organic-vegas-sot-r1 gates are satisfied, partial, absent, or blocked by human review.
phase.gate: HALT: Present Audit Findings, verified path mapping, missing-script handling, and a reconstructed implementation plan to the Director before mutation.

phase.step: Establish or adapt ThemeRegistry.ts using the Three Tissues token system: Gold, Neon, and Obsidian. If the target theme registry path is absent, prove the nearest existing theme architecture first.
Refactor OrganicVegasScene.tsx toward Single-Mesh or Dynamic-Material pool optimization only after measuring or identifying the actual performance pressure.
Bind ERK_5AxisVector or the verified receptor equivalent to shader intensities and musical phrase generation through typed adaptors.
phase.gate: VERIFY: Build succeeds; DSP and physics-heavy work remain isolated from main-thread DSP execution; Sacred Core protected paths are unchanged unless separately approved.

phase.step: Implement or adapt PhraseGenerator.ts for deterministic 4-bar and 8-bar melodic generation based on gameplay tension and verified leitmotif structures.
Develop ViralShard and ShadowBlocker entities using source-truth visual DNA: Ice-Stone grain and Matte Obsidian contrast. Treat imagery as inert reference only.
Deploy a NeuralLattice background through SVG or Canvas using mix-blend-mode screen only if it preserves readability and performance budgets.
phase.gate: VERIFY: Tests or probes confirm leitmotif stability, deterministic seed behavior, and Neural Twitch particle performance within budget.

phase.step: Run a 10,000-generation Monte Carlo simulation through existing packages/farkle-engine/src/monteCarlo.ts and rtpConfig.ts, or create scripts/simulateEconomy.ts only as a proven wrapper around existing APIs.
Integrate HMAC-SHA256 Provably Fair audit panel as UI/audit presentation unless backend authority support already exists and is verified.
Bind The Archivist and The Conductor class mechanics through wrapper/adaptor mechanics only. No direct edits to scorer math, CSPRNG, RTP config, or gameRoom.ts authority unless separately approved.
phase.gate: VERIFY: Simulation report confirms Life-Force and RTP stability within 2% tolerance.

phase.step: Run final frame-pacing audit and eliminate any main-thread task greater than 50ms in the target Organic Vegas flow.
Validate server-side turn authority in apps/backend/src/gameRoom.ts without mutating authority unless separately approved.
Confirm snappy tap/drag controls, deterministic remote animation presentation, reconnect-safe ranked outcomes, and no unnecessary inputs.
Establish final beta release build for dream-core branch only after vertical-slice and verification gates pass.
phase.gate: TERMINATION: Mission complete only after final build, audit summary, residual-risk list, and beta readiness verdict are delivered.

escalation_rules.rule: Immediately reduce particle counts, shader complexity, post-processing, or entity update frequency if main-thread tasks exceed 50ms.
Offload additional composition logic to audio workers or worklets if frame-time jitter or DSP latency appears.
Invoke the Uncertainty Protocol instead of fabricating paths, scripts, modules, or dependencies.
Nerf, move to experience-only, or reject payout-affecting mechanics that exceed the 2% RTP tolerance.
Patch shortcuts, softlocks, gotchas, or unnecessary inputs before adding more content.

required_responses.response: Include verified branch hash, source-truth files read, path map, missing dependencies or scripts, gate status, protected paths, and implementation plan reconstructed from evidence.
When required, output exactly four options labeled a, b, c, d. Each option must state impact, risk, and the evidence needed to proceed.
At each gate, report what changed, what was verified, what remains blocked by human review, and whether the next phase is allowed.
Include changed-file summary, commands run, test/build results, RTP/performance evidence, beta readiness verdict, residual risks, and the next three highest-leverage follow-ups.
